description: Left, Up, Right - the action is all around.

lighting.rule: Omit every tile with a nonzero luminance byte; preserve non-light tiles on all eight layers.

actor_sprites.state: Representative idle object frames; powerups shown available; neutral palette 0.
actor_sprites.compositing: After background tiles and before foreground tiles, at original signed sprite anchors.
actor_sprites.limitations: No animation, live surveillance feeds, runtime shadows or team/weapon palette effects.

reference_image.note: Lighting off. Static game-object sprites plus explicit spawn and source-only markers; no parallax or runtime lighting.
